summary: Build a professional data-selling application named IBN with a polished UI and a WhatsApp contact link for more details.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal modern wordmark logo reading "IBN" (ibn-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Subtle abstract tech background for a hero section (ibn-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png)

existing_features.title: Create a branded application shell named "IBN" that clearly presents the app as a professional data-selling application, including the app name in the header and page title/metadata.

Implement a clean landing page layout suitable for a data-selling business, including sections for: a short hero headline, a brief description, and a visible call-to-action to contact via WhatsApp for more details.
Add a WhatsApp contact link/button that opens WhatsApp chat for the phone number 09033449260.
Apply a coherent, professional visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, components) across the UI suitable for a commercial data-selling brand; use a consistent design system across all screens.
Provide a simple "Data Plans" (or equivalent) section on the landing page that lists example data bundle offerings (static, editable in code) with name, price, and brief description.
Include a footer with basic business/contact text and a repeated WhatsApp contact link for 09033449260.
Add generated brand assets (logo and a subtle hero background/illustration) as static images and render them in the UI from the frontend public assets folder.
